licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge, a separate sweep for dynamics, hairpins, slurs and ties, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation is left out. Bars 74–80 are for the piano alone. In bars 23–28 the print gives the right hand a trilled dotted 32nd followed by two 128th notes, which the file cannot hold: the trilled note is written as a 16th with a trill, and the two tiny notes as grace notes before the next note. The cut signs printed above the barlines at bars 63 and 67 are not written in the score. Playback tempo: an eighth note = 48 (♩ = 24), from Jacobs (4:59); Mozart gives the words Andante cantabile only.
